text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(To revive the shop with stylish Japanese 
sweets made for Valentine's... 
With Valentine's Day as our goal, we 
sprang into action.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(The first thing we decided to do 
was...'research' the popular shops! 
We all headed out to scout the 
competition!)

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for waiting! 
Here is our Advanced Chocolate Kingdom 
Cinnamon Roll!

text_block_list.name: All
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see. The base is a cinnamon roll 
with marbled chocolate. 
And on top, a prince and princess sculpted 
from chocolate.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fascinating... The theme is a radiant 
sparkle. By weaving romance and chocolate 
together, they've crafted a confection 
that truly embodies the concept of 
Valentine's.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...? So with a super-sparkly, 
romance-and-chocolate mix-and-match, the 
marbled prince and princess are...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san... please don't strain 
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Thanks for waiting! 
Here is the Quartet Chocolate Cake with 
Petit Choux!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
My goodness, the chocolate work looks just 
like a musical score?! 
And those teeny cream puffs are so darn 
cute...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What do we do, what do we do?! 
It feels so sad to break it apart and eat 
ittt!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Then let's preserve its appearance with a 
commemorative photo before we eat! 
Everyone, line uuup!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ticket-san! Squeeze in a little 
closer, closer... 
All right, picture perfect!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Are we on a sightseeing trip...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, that was delicious! 
This Class Rep is thoroughly satisfied! 
Thank you for the meal!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal!! 
...Wait, huh? Was that why we came here?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You forgot again, didn't you... 
...What's wrong, Yukino-san...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, ya see... 
Every shop we visited was just so amazin', 
I got totally swept up in it all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...If we don't come up with a wagashi just 
as good—no, way better than theirs— 
we won't stand a chance. ...Hrmmm—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Yukino-san. I'm not sure if this will 
be of any help, but... 
how about something like this?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
For instance, this shop... sells cookies, 
scones, and the like 
with the tagline "confections to enjoy 
with coffee"... and it's quite popular.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Along those lines... while green tea 
usually comes to mind for wagashi... 
creating a wagashi to be enjoyed with all 
sorts of drinks... might be an option.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are so many different angles we 
could take. Along those lines— 
what I'd personally love to showcase is 
the innate beauty of traditional wagashi 
designs.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
With Valentine's Day as our motif, 
the potential for new "brilliance" is 
truly limitless. For example—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The classic heart shape. And since it's 
Valentine's Day, after all, 
we could also model them after cupids, 
flower bouquets, or present boxes.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Along that theme, a rose wagashi based on 
the language of flowers could work nicely 
too. 
A nerikiri with a gradient of crimson and 
dark brown—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of Flight-san... 
She's just like a professional artist...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh! As expected of the Fashion Class 
Rep...! 
As Class Representative, I refuse to be 
outdone!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I present a clever, 
Bakushin-style Valentine wagashi! 
I dub it... the "Bakushin Thank-You 
Sakuramochi"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank-You Sakuramochi...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day is a day to express your 
gratitude to those who look after you! 
And that is precisely where the "Bakushin 
Thank-You Sakuramochi" shines!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it looks like an ordinary 
sakuramochi... but once you peel back the 
leaf, 
behold! A message of heartfelt thanks is 
written in chocolate right underneath!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see... tackling it from a surprise angle 
to fit a special event... 
That's so very like you, Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Such is the Bakushin ingenuity of 
your Class Rep! 
I've got plenty more ideas where that came 
from~!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A battle of ideas... has begun, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A match where neither can back down, 
precisely because they're rivals who 
respect each other's strength! 
It's so intense! You're both on fire!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...A showdown... rivals...? 
......

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah!! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. A wagashi showdown between Bakushin 
O-chan and Flight-chan... 
using that to hype up the shop until 
Valentine's Day, you say?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It seems like both of 'em have a 
whole bunch of ideas for new sweets. 
I thought a showdown event'd be a great 
way to promote the new items, too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Every day, we can give a win point based 
on which wagashi sold more. 
We'll put up a scoreboard inside the shop!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
People might come back just to see how the 
results turned out, right? 
Plus, I'm plannin' to give real-time 
commentary on the sales!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What do ya think...? 
Don't ya think it'd really bring in the 
customers...?

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
What a clever idea... Alright, then I'll 
roll up my sleeves and get back to work 
for the first time in a while. 
With some help from Bakushin O-chan and 
the others, of course.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A-Awesome, Sensei!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I won't lose, Bakushin O-chan. 
I'm going to come out on top in this 
wagashi showdown!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just what I wanted to hear! Let me show 
you that 
a Class Rep can be a representative in any 
field whatsoever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...I can't let everyone's hard work go to 
waste.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who pitched the idea in the 
first place— 
I've gotta fire myself up and give it 
everything I've got, more than anyone 
else!
